extract-pdf-attachments-and-list-names.title: Extract PDF Attachments and List Their Original Names
extract-pdf-attachments-and-list-names.description: Shows how to extract embedded files from a PDF using PdfExtractor and then write each attachment's original filename to a text file.

extract-pdf-attachments-report__v2.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Generate a Report
extract-pdf-attachments-report__v2.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to extract embedded files from a PDF, save them to a folder, and create a text report indicating the extraction status of each attachment.

extract-pdf-annotations.title: Extract All Annotations from a PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor
extract-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document to a PdfAnnotationEditor, extract every annotation across all pages, and write their details to a text file.

extract-freetext-and-text-annotations.title: Extract FreeText and Text Annotations from a PDF
extract-freetext-and-text-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, filter annotations by type (FreeText and Text), and write their details to a text file.

extract-freetext-and-text-annotations__v.title: Extract FreeText and Text Annotations from PDF Pages
extract-freetext-and-text-annotations__v.description: Demonstrates how to use PdfAnnotationEditor to extract FreeText and Text annotations from the first five pages of a PDF document.

extract-freetext-annotations.title: Extract FreeText Annotations from PDF
extract-freetext-annotations.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through all pages, locate FreeText annotations, and write their text contents to a .txt file.

extract-text-annotations-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Text Annotations from PDF Pages
extract-text-annotations-from-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over a specific page range, and write the contents of all text annotations (sticky notes) to a text file.

extract-freetext-annotations-from-pages.title: Extract FreeText Annotations from Specific PDF Pages
extract-freetext-annotations-from-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate pages 2‑4, extract the contents of FreeText annotations, and save them to a text file.

extract-text-annotations.title: Extract Text Annotations from PDF
extract-text-annotations.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, filter only Text (sticky‑note) annotations, and save their contents to a plain‑text file.

extract-freetext-and-text-annotations__v.title: Extract FreeText and Text Annotations from PDF
extract-freetext-and-text-annotations__v.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through all pages, retrieve the contents of FreeText and Text annotations, and save them to a text file.

extract-all-annotation-types.title: Extract All Annotation Types from PDF
extract-all-annotation-types.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through each page, and writes the type of every annotation along with its page number to a text file.

extract-freetext-annotations-last-five-p.title: Extract FreeText Annotations from Last Five PDF Pages
extract-freetext-annotations-last-five-p.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating over the last five pages, collecting FreeText annotation contents, and writing them to a text file.

extract-annotation-text-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Annotation Text from Specific PDF Pages
extract-annotation-text-from-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over pages 10‑15, collect the Contents of each annotation, and write the collected text to a .txt file.

count-pdf-annotations.title: Count PDF Annotations and Write to Text File
count-pdf-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages to count the total number of annotations, and writes the count to a text file.

extract-pdf-annotations-to-text.title: Extract PDF Annotations to Text File
extract-pdf-annotations-to-text.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page and its annotations, and writes the annotation contents to a plain text file.

load-a-pdf-detect-whether-it-contains-te.title: Load A Pdf Detect Whether It Contains Text Using Pdfextractor And Write The Result To A Text File

detect-images-in-pdf-to-json.title: Detect Images in PDF and Output Result to JSON
detect-images-in-pdf-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, uses PdfExtractor to determine whether the document contains any images, and writes the detection result to a JSON file.

detect-text-and-images-in-pdf-to-csv.title: Detect Text and Images in PDF and Save Results to CSV
detect-text-and-images-in-pdf-to-csv.description: The example loads a PDF, uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to determine whether the document contains any text and/or images, and writes the detection results to a CSV file.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt__v6.title: Extract Text from PDF to TXT using PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt__v6.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, extract its text using UTF‑8 encoding, and write the extracted content to a .txt file.

extract-images-from-pdf__v15.title: Extract Images from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-images-from-pdf__v15.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file, extract all embedded images with Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor, and save each image as a PNG file to a designated folder.

detect-pdf-images-and-write-presence.title: Detect Images in a PDF and Write Presence Result
detect-pdf-images-and-write-presence.description: Loads a PDF, uses Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to check if any images are present, and writes the detection result to a text file.

extract-first-image-from-pdf__v2.title: Extract First Image from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-first-image-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, extract the first image on the first page with Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor, and save it as a PNG file.

detect-pdf-images-and-write-result.title: Detect Images in a PDF Using PdfExtractor
detect-pdf-images-and-write-result.description: Loads a PDF file, checks whether it contains any images using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and writes the boolean result (true/false) to a text file.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdf__v2.title: Extract Text and Images from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-text-and-images-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, extracting its text and all images with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and writing the results and a summary file to disk.
